definitions.mdd_raw: Same engine minute-close raw wallet+unrealized equity, fees deducted, rebate excluded
definitions.mdd_rebate_exact: Every minute close raw equity + ACTUAL cumulative70% rebates at that instant
definitions.mdd_legacy: Only for old dashboard baseline comparability:15m raw curve + final total rebate apportioned by closed trade count, approximate
definitions.monthly: Month-end minus prior month-end equity INCLUDING actual cumulative rebate70%; mark-to-market, includes open PnL; partial first/last months
definitions.max_margin: Same existing minute-close engine metric margin/equity RAW; no guarantee<=50%, guard is pre-order only
definitions.cyc_realized: Closed cyc trade pnl and pnl_rebate fields, both entry/exit fees allocated, rebate70 included in pnl_rebate
definitions.open: Every STILL OPEN cyc add across all sessions, not just active-session additions; gross mark-to-market and remaining-entry-fee/rebate-aware PnL; prospective exit estimate separately labeled
definitions.skip: Otherwise eligible new rescue-add third-tick signals blocked by pre-placement unrounded margin>=50%; not candle count, not rechecks; no fill-time or prospective cap
definitions.repayment: 3m sorted losing initial held first; only when none left SAME-session >=24h adds next. User ABS unit formula; exact mark +/-0.05%, no extra SLIP; estimate fee.05%, actualtaker.042%/rebate70%, proportional entry fees and residual original TP. Legacy100% closes held first but ROI<0 residual side keeps rescue.
definitions.old_add_targets: Only zero remaining original held permits SAME-session filled adds age>=24h at3m close. Young and prior-session adds untouched. User ABS loss+estimatedfee formula applies to ALL eligible old adds including flat/profitable; differs from source signed-loss filter. ROI>=0/flat ends only when held absent; legacy100% still closes held but then uses this ROI gate.
definitions.filter_counts: Normal logical pending-entry plans / market attempts. Each new plan attempted once; rejected placement vs later pending cancellation separated. Per-rule counts overlap when multiple conditions match; totals are unique events, not sum-of-rules. Includes plans held by other baseline controls, NOT counterfactual successful fills exclusively prevented by filter. blocked_side_minutes counts each enabled rule once per side at minute-open; denominator side_minutes=2*replayed1m candles. No per-minute repeated cancellation counts.
definitions.filter_timing: Minute OPEN currentprice, completed HTF close<=minuteopen; cancel normal pending BEFORE samebar fills. After on_1m, update completedUTC HTF with thisminute then close-bar placement uses minuteclose and newlycompletedHTF. Market triggers also checked at modeled triggerprice; minute OHLC cannot prove intrabar gate crossings. No queue/volume model; inherited fillmechanics unchanged.
definitions.missing_history: ZIP fail-open for unknown; paper explicitly fetches70prewarmupdays publicUTC1h/4h/daily and HARDERROR if any enabled indicator unavailable. No silent disable. Inherited strategy13daywarmup untouched; filters have separate earlier lookback. WilderRSI14 seeded meanfirst14changes, flat=50.
